prompt: Where are the names of the drinks kept until scoring ends?
promptZh: 評分結束前，飲料的品名放在哪裡？

options.whyZh: 杯貼提供兩字母代碼，不公開品名。

options.text: In the space for a numeric score
options.zh: 在填寫數字分數的位置
options.whyZh: 評分欄是給小組成員填記結果，不是公開品名的位置。
備料台用配置圖補製樣品；本文說品名表封存於信封。
首段直接交代評分都完成前將品名封存。

explanationZh: 首段直接交代評分都完成前將品名封存。
evidence: The tasting team compares three drinks without seeing the brand names. Use only the two-letter codes printed on the cup stickers when recording scores. The product names remain in a sealed envelope until every panel member has finished scoring.

vocabulary.note: 信封封口後，內容不能直接看見。
